Style: 1970s comic book art: bold black ink outlines, hand-inked hatching, flat printed colours with visible halftone dots, slightly off-register colour printing, muted earthy palette of browns, ochres, olive and amber, on aged newsprint. Mood: quiet, still and mysterious, a place long left alone.
